text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can produce art, music and writing that look or sound surprisingly human. You can ask a computer to paint a picture, compose a song or write a short story in seconds. However, human creativity is still different. People create from emotions, personal experiences and imagination, while machines simply learn from existing data and follow patterns. AI can support artists by offering new ideas and saving time, but it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. In the end, AI is a useful tool, not a replacement for human imagination.
